verdict.rationale: The pack holds verbatim guidance text from several public pages (nj.gov/treasury/revenue/, gettingregistered.shtml, and the njportal.com BusinessRegistration and BusinessFormation pages). That suggests the reading surface was fetched and its text extracted, so it is not an empty JS-only shell. However, no item says how the pages were fetched or confirms there is no bot wall, CAPTCHA or user-agent filtering, so reachability is only inferred. missing for 10: explicit evidence of keyless retrieval with an identified user agent, confirmation that no bot wall or CAPTCHA sits in front of the pages, confirmation that content is server-rendered rather than JS-dependent, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
